headline: ARCward Intelligence moves into ARC-2 gold

sections.text: ARCward Intelligence climbed from 17th to 13th, gaining 8.75 points to reach 54.17.
That puts the team inside the 15 gold places, after sitting just outside the medal band in the previous observation.
